verdict.rationale: Mercury documents automations (auto-funding rules, AI bookkeeping automations, automatic invoices), so versioning and rolling them back is a fair question for this product. The pack shows no capability to version, diff, review, or revert an automation's configuration. API path versioning, the changelog, and approval queues for individual payments are adjacent features and earn no credit; keeping agent skills in a git repo would be a user-side workaround.
